title: Output under flipped transitions
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input and output, and let $x$ and $w$ be Boolean words. The output of the machine obtained by flipping $N$’s output, when run on $x$ under choices $w$, is the word obtained by applying Boolean negation to each symbol of the output of $N$ on the same input and choices.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Booleans
caveat: The supplied statement uses $N$’s flipped-output machine but does not include its definition; the prose describes its apparent meaning.
